llc.formation_doc: Articles of Organization - Louisiana Limited Liability Company (Form 365) with Initial Report
llc.formation_notes: Fee raised from $100 to $125 effective 2026-10-01 under Act 921 of the 2026 Regular Session. Third parties mention a small online service charge, not verified.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: each year on or before the anniversary date of organization (per third-party guides; not read on sos.la.gov)

sources.title: Louisiana Secretary of State Fee Schedule effective 10/1/26
sources.quote: Effective October 1, 2026, the fees for the Commercial Division of the Secretary of State will increase in accordance with Act 921

sources.title: Fee Schedule effective 10/1/26 - Domestic LLCs
sources.quote: Articles of Organization-Louisiana Limited Liability Company $125 ... Annual Reports $35

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Entities taxed as partnerships or S corps may elect (Form R-6980, R.S. 47:287.732.2) to be taxed at entity level; LDR FAQ on PTE-election rates answers with the flat 3% rate for periods from 2025. Exact entity rate not separately confirmed.

sources.title: LDR Revenue Information Bulletin 25-032 (Act 382 of 2025)
sources.quote: As of January 1, 2026, Louisiana (La. R.S. 47:287.732) now recognizes S corporations as flow-through entities consistent with federal income tax treatment.

sources.title: LDR FAQ: rates for S corps and PTE-election entities
sources.quote: For taxable periods beginning on or after January 1, 2025, the individual income tax rate is a flat 3%.

sources.title: LDR FAQ: Is the corporation franchise tax repealed?
sources.quote: The franchise tax has been repealed for franchise tax periods beginning on or after January 1, 2026.

personal_exemption.notes: Personal exemption folded into the standard deduction since 2025. Standard deduction indexed to CPI-U (R.S. 47:294(B)); LDR says official 2026 amounts may differ slightly from the $12,875/$25,750 used in withholding tables and the 2026 IT-540ES worksheet. HOH $25,750.

sources.title: La. R.S. 47:32
sources.quote: taxable income of an individual shall be computed at the rate of three percent on net income.

sources.title: 2026 IT-540ES instructions
sources.quote: Beginning January 1, 2026, the individual income tax is computed at a tax rate of 3 percent.

sources.title: RIB 26-005
sources.quote: a standard deduction of $12,875 was used for single and married-filing-separately taxpayers, and $25,750 for married-filing-jointly

estimated_tax.required_if: estimated Louisiana tax after credits and withholding expected to exceed $1,000 (single) or $2,000 (joint)

unemployment_2026.notes: laworks.net blocks automated reading. Secondary sources: 2026 wage base $7,000 (down from $7,700); new employers pay their industry average rate (min 1%). Not verified.

notable: Flat 3% income tax with a $12,875 / $25,750 standard deduction in 2026 (https://dam.ldr.la.gov/taxforms/IT540ESi-2026.pdf)
From 2026 S corporations are true pass-throughs: no more Louisiana corporation income tax at entity level (https://dam.ldr.la.gov/lawspolicies/RIB%2025-032.pdf)
LLC fees went up on 2026-10-01: $125 to form, $35 annual report (https://static.sos.la.gov/shared/fee_changes_2026.pdf)
No local income taxes; parishes and cities do levy occupational license taxes on businesses (not researched).
uncertain: Official 2026 standard deduction may differ slightly from $12,875/$25,750 (LDR's own caveat in RIB 26-005).
Annual report due date (anniversary) and late consequences not read on sos.la.gov (pages 404/blocked).
Rate paid by entities making the PTE election not separately confirmed (LDR FAQ answer gives the 3% individual rate).
SUTA 2026 wage base and new employer rate not read on laworks.net (403).
Local occupational license taxes (gross-receipts based) not researched.
